# docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md, "Draft, bill and passage". Country scope. Read by
# te_tax_bill_effects.txt, te_tax_triggers.txt, te_tax_support_values.txt and the support
# refresh (te_tax_gen_refresh_support); every variable read is guarded with has_variable,
# and none writes or iterates anything, so a GUI may read them too.

# One vanilla tax level per channel, for the support model's delta-levels.
te_tax_level_step_wage = 0.05
te_tax_level_step_div = 0.05
te_tax_level_step_land = 0.15
te_tax_level_step_head = 0.15
te_tax_level_step_cons = 0.05

# te_tax_base_<record>_<key>: the index in force under existing law in the draft's (dr) or
# the bill's (bl) due month: the enacted value, its successor if its sunset falls by then,
# then each awaiting package due earlier (one due on or after it is superseded at
# approval), with that package's own sunset preview. The draft's untouched provisions
# start from it; the bill's support model measures change against it.

				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_div
				var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_div
				var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pb_div
				var:te_tax_pb_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pb_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pb_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pb_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pb_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ
			}
		}
	}
}

# te_tax_base_<record>_<relief>: the relief band in force under existing law in the record's
# due month (relief has no sunset): the enacted band, then each awaiting package due earlier.
te_tax_base_dr_agrel = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_agrel } value = var:te_tax_en_agrel }
	# Awaiting packages due earlier, in the order they commence.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_agrel var:te_tax_pb_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_agrel }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_agrel var:te_tax_pa_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_agrel }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_agrel var:te_tax_pa_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_agrel }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_agrel var:te_tax_pb_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_agrel }
	}
}

# te_tax_dr_eff_<key>: the draft's target, or the baseline when the draft leaves it alone.
te_tax_dr_eff_wage = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_wage
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_wage var:te_tax_dr_wage >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_wage }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_div = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_div
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_div var:te_tax_dr_div >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_div }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_land = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_land
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_land var:te_tax_dr_land >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_land }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_head = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_head
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_head var:te_tax_dr_head >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_head }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_cons = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_cons
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_cons var:te_tax_dr_cons >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_cons }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_agrel = {

	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_agrel var:te_tax_dr_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_agrel }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_regrel var:te_tax_dr_regrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_regrel }
}

# te_tax_dr_zero_limit_<key>: Traditionalism's test that the draft levies no such tax,
# written with the draft's index on the left (te_tax_draft_ready):
#   var:te_tax_dr_<key> = 0  OR  var:te_tax_dr_<key> <= te_tax_dr_zero_limit_<key>
# The limit is -1 when existing law in the draft's month has no such tax and -2 when it
# has, so an untouched provision (-1) passes exactly when that law levies none, and a
# touched one only at 0.
te_tax_dr_zero_limit_wage = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_wage
	max = 1
	multiply = -1
	add = -1
}
te_tax_dr_zero_limit_div = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_div
	max = 1
	multiply = -1
	add = -1
}

# te_tax_base_<record>_g_<good>: 1 if the good is taxed under existing law in the
# draft's (dr) or the bill's (bl) due month.
te_tax_base_dr_g_aeroplanes = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes } value = var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes }
	# Awaiting packages due earlier, in the order they commence.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes }
	}
}

		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_bl_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_g_tourism var:te_tax_pb_g_tourism >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_g_tourism }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_g_tourism var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_g_tourism var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_bl_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_g_tourism var:te_tax_pb_g_tourism >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_g_tourism }
	}
}

# The bill's goods, in tax levels on the consumption channel: 0.2 per good it puts on
# the taxed list (negative for one it takes off), times the good's category weight
# (GOODS_CATEGORY_WEIGHT in the generator, from the goods file's category). One value per
# good, so a later provision can zero a single good's term; te_tax_dl_goods is their sum.

# Revenue direction: the sum of the changes. Progressivity: income channels minus the rest.
te_tax_dl_total = {
	value = te_tax_dl_wage
	add = te_tax_dl_div
	add = te_tax_dl_land
	add = te_tax_dl_head
	add = te_tax_dl_cons
}
te_tax_dl_prog = {
	value = te_tax_dl_wage
	add = te_tax_dl_div
	subtract = te_tax_dl_land
	subtract = te_tax_dl_head
	subtract = te_tax_dl_cons
}

# How many provisions the bill changes.
te_tax_bl_provisions = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_wage var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_div var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_land var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_head var:te_tax_bl_head >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_cons var:te_tax_bl_cons >= 0 } add = 1 }
}

# Support reasons per interest group, each clamped to -40..40. Material:
# -10 x the exposure-weighted change in tax levels, the bill's goods counted on the
# consumption channel (te_tax_dl_goods); then relief in points per band the bill moves it:
# agricultural rural_folk +8, landowners +3; regional +4 for every group,
# industrialists -2, petty_bourgeoisie -2 on top. Ideology: 5 x the
# group's fiscal ideology (its stances on the vanilla taxation laws x their progressiveness
# / 100) x the change in progressivity. Government: +10 in government.
te_tax_mat_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_wage multiply = 0.3 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_div multiply = 0.2 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_land multiply = 0.1 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_head multiply = 0.3 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_cons multiply = 0.4 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_goods multiply = 0.4 }
	multiply = -10
	add = { value = te_tax_bl_dstep_regrel multiply = 4 }
	min = -40
	max = 40
}
te_tax_ideo_p_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	# law_consumption_based_taxation, progressiveness -100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 1 }
	# law_land_based_taxation, progressiveness -50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	# law_proportional_taxation, progressiveness 50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	# law_graduated_taxation, progressiveness 100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > approve } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -1 }
}
te_tax_ideo_armed_forces = {
	value = te_tax_ideo_p_armed_forces
	multiply = te_tax_dl_prog
	multiply = 5
	min = -40
	max = 40
}
te_tax_gov_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { is_in_government = yes } } value = 10 }
}

	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 1 }
	# law_land_based_taxation, progressiveness -50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	# law_proportional_taxation, progressiveness 50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	# law_graduated_taxation, progressiveness 100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > approve } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -1 }
}
te_tax_ideo_rural_folk = {
	value = te_tax_ideo_p_rural_folk
	multiply = te_tax_dl_prog
	multiply = 5
	min = -40
	max = 40
}
te_tax_gov_rural_folk = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { is_in_government = yes } } value = 10 }
}
te_tax_mat_trade_unions = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_wage multiply = 1 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_head multiply = 0.8 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_cons multiply = 0.8 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_goods multiply = 0.8 }
	multiply = -10
	add = { value = te_tax_bl_dstep_regrel multiply = 4 }
	min = -40
	max = 40
}
te_tax_ideo_p_trade_unions = {
	value = 0
	# law_consumption_based_taxation, progressiveness -100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 1 }
	# law_land_based_taxation, progressiveness -50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	# law_proportional_taxation, progressiveness 50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	# law_graduated_taxation, progressiveness 100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > approve } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -1 }
}

# Clout of the non-marginal interest groups, and of those among them committed to the
# bill's current revision (te_tax_committed_share, te_tax_support_values.txt). A marginal
# group (vanilla's ig_counts_as_marginal) counts in neither; a group the country lacks
# contributes nothing.
te_tax_eligible_clout = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
	}
}
te_tax_committed_clout = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_com_armed_forces = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout
			var:te_tax_com_devout = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_devout_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists
			var:te_tax_com_industrialists = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_industrialists_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners
			var:te_tax_com_landowners = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_landowners_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_com_rural_folk = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_com_trade_unions = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
	}
}

# Clout of the non-marginal groups that are persuadable (not committed, no red line, a
# score of 0 or more): the passage bar's pale segment (te_tax_view_open_share).
te_tax_open_clout = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_com_armed_forces = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_sup_armed_forces >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout
			var:te_tax_com_devout = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_devout
			var:te_tax_sup_devout >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists
			var:te_tax_com_industrialists = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_industrialists
			var:te_tax_sup_industrialists >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_sup_intelligentsia >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners
			var:te_tax_com_landowners = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_landowners
			var:te_tax_sup_landowners >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_com_rural_folk = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_sup_rural_folk >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_com_trade_unions = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_sup_trade_unions >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
	}
}

# The panels' draft class and "reverts to" preview (plan Task 8). te_tax_dr_dstep_<key>
# and te_tax_dr_provisions are the bill's values for the draft, so the workbench can show
# the class the bill would have (te_tax_draft_is_minor, te_tax_triggers.txt).
te_tax_dr_dstep_wage = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_wage var:te_tax_dr_wage >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_wage
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_wage
	}
}
te_tax_dr_dstep_div = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_div var:te_tax_dr_div >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_div
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_div
	}
}
te_tax_dr_dstep_land = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_land var:te_tax_dr_land >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_land
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_land
	}
}
te_tax_dr_dstep_head = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_head var:te_tax_dr_head >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_head
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_head
	}
}
te_tax_dr_dstep_cons = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_cons var:te_tax_dr_cons >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_cons
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_cons
	}
}
te_tax_dr_provisions = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_wage var:te_tax_dr_wage >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_div var:te_tax_dr_div >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_land var:te_tax_dr_land >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_head var:te_tax_dr_head >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_cons var:te_tax_dr_cons >= 0 } add = 1 }
}

# te_tax_succ_dr_<key>: the index a sunset in the draft would revert to (scheduler rule 3
# at the draft's due month; the review's "then reverts to").
te_tax_succ_dr_wage = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_wage } value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
	# Any pending enacted sunset: its successor is the underlying rate.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_en_wage_exp
			has_variable = te_tax_en_wage_succ
			var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
			var:te_tax_en_wage_succ >= 0
		}
		value = var:te_tax_en_wage_succ
	}
	# Awaiting packages due earlier, in the order they commence.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pb_wage
				var:te_tax_pb_wage >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pb_wage
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_wage_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_wage_succ
					var:te_tax_pb_wage_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pb_wage_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_wage_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage
				var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_wage
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_wage_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage
				var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_wage
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_wage_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pb_wage
				var:te_tax_pb_wage >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pb_wage
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_wage_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_wage_succ
					var:te_tax_pb_wage_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pb_wage_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_wage_succ
			}
		}
	}
}
te_tax_succ_dr_div = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_div } value = var:te_tax_en_div }
	# Any pending enacted sunset: its successor is the underlying rate.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_en_div_exp
			has_variable = te_tax_en_div_succ
			var:te_tax_en_div_exp >= 0
			var:te_tax_en_div_succ >= 0
		}
		value = var:te_tax_en_div_succ
	}
	# Awaiting packages due earlier, in the order they commence.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pb_div
				var:te_tax_pb_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pb_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pb_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pb_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_div
				var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_div
				var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_exp
